title: Shortcut behavior
description: How keyboard and mouse shortcuts behave

options.label: Back and forth
options.description: Switching to the current workspace returns to the previous one

options.label: Remember previous workspace
options.description: Workspaces remember where you came from

options.label: Hide special workspace
options.description: Changing workspace also hides the special workspace

options.label: Center cursor on
options.description: Where the cursor is placed when switching workspaces

options.label: Cycle fullscreen windows
options.description: Moving focus from a fullscreen window cycles through windows

options.label: Cycle within group first
options.description: Moving focus cycles through group tabs before leaving the group

options.label: Cross monitors
options.description: Moving a window or focus past a monitor edge continues on the next monitor

options.label: Focus search method
options.description: How the next window is picked when moving focus in a direction

options.label: Fullscreen pinned windows
options.description: Allow pinned windows to be fullscreen

options.label: Ignore group lock
options.description: Group commands work even on locked groups

options.label: Pass clicks through binds
options.description: Also send a bound mouse click to the app under the cursor

options.label: Scroll delay
options.description: How long to wait after a scroll event before passing the next one

options.label: Drag threshold
options.description: Pointer travel needed before a click turns into a drag. 0 disables

options.label: Block keybind grabbing
options.description: Do not let apps disable your shortcuts
